subject.title: [Bug]: clearUnboundScopes strips operator scopes unconditionally for non-local token-auth clients

question: Should device-less non-local shared-token/password WebSocket operator clients receive write/admin scopes, and if so should those scopes come only from configured token policy rather than client-declared connect scopes?
rationale: Current main intentionally clears self-declared scopes for this class of client, while the reported workflow needs operator.write; choosing the fix changes the Gateway auth boundary and cannot be resolved safely as a mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Bounded configured token scopes
options.body: Land a reviewed token-scope/device-trust policy that grants explicit configured scopes under documented exposure limits instead of trusting client-declared scopes.

options.title: Retain client-declared scopes
options.body: Allow valid shared-token clients to keep requested scopes directly, accepting the broader shared-secret authorization boundary.

options.title: Require device identity for write scopes
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed behavior and require device pairing or another identity-bearing path for operator.write/admin use.

recommendation.title: Bounded configured token scopes
recommendation.body: Land a reviewed token-scope/device-trust policy that grants explicit configured scopes under documented exposure limits instead of trusting client-declared scopes.
